cat lariat necklace taxco 925 silver hoops vintage beaded necklace marc jacobs owl ring claire's emo necklace
3. huge sunnies obvi so u can be awkward in peace
giant vintage oversized frames giant vintage boho frames
4. big messy hair we dgaf not everyone has hair like u so let it free! 5. the character of your pants is everything. washes and silhouttes set the whole tone and must not be overlooked. i build most of my outfits around the pants. 6. if you can get away with it, wear flip flops or flats. i love heel bite, black on the bottom of my jeans, frays dragging on the ground, and then right next to it ur bare and probably gross feet are out too! it creates an interesting contrast imo.

Balzac:

Written 1831 paris

Themes of desire and unchecked ambition

Mortality , consequences of actions, luxury and excess

Faustian bargain: a pact where someone sacrifices their moral integrity, soul, or core values for short-term power, knowledge, wealth, or pleasure

Raphael is hella feminine and mercurial almost and never satisfied and so dramatic.

in this state of yearning without reciprocation - so similar to now where no one is getting who they want

Theatrical circus or cabaret vibe
